display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Cache state (sorted by frequency):
Lowest freq ─────────── Highest freq

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Entry D has lowest frequency (correct eviction target).
But entry C with freq=50 was popular yesterday and is cold
today.
A new hot entry E has freq=10 but is still below C.
LFU retains C (cold but historical high freq). WRONG.
LFU should evict C to make room for E.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Cache state (sorted by access time):
Most recent ─────────── Least recent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Entry B was accessed 120 seconds ago (least recent).
But entry B is a configuration value accessed 1,000 times/day.
Entry D was accessed just now but is a one-hit-wonder.
LRU evicts B (the configuration value). WRONG.
LRU should evict D (the one-hit-wonder).

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
No single policy avoids all priority inversions.
Adaptive policies (ARC) handle the widest range of patterns.
